title: glacial-seismic-sensitivity-utac - P133: Early-stage sensitivity tests of glacial-unloading seismicity
description: Does the same seasonal ice/snow unloading trigger more earthquakes over time? Pre-registered 'early-stage' (Fruehstadium) sensitivity tests on national and global earthquake catalogues near shrinking mountain glaciers and ice sheets versus control regions, a criticality/early-warning indicator battery, a simple viscoelastic GIA + rate-and-state lag/detectability model with published mantle viscosities, and a frozen confirmatory test on data from 2026-11-01 onward. v0.1.0 adds tipping-trajectory scenarios (accelerating ice loss), a deceptive pre-tipping quiet analysis, ETAS/Habermann quiescence classification and pre-registered GRACE/GNSS/seismicity monitoring indicators. v0.2.0 adds a temporal ETAS model with a yearly residual background (H2, retrospective), body-tide phase tests (H3), catalogue-robustness checks, a lag sensitivity informed by Sasgen et al. 2026, and a preregistered prospective test of background change from 2027-01-01 (C2) with a dated, frozen addendum (PREREGISTRATION_v0.2_NACHTRAG.md) and an erratum to the null calibration. Companion of glacial-seismicity-utac (P101). Deliberately has NO UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge. See DISCLAIMER.md. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (P133, registry class KLIMA-KRYO-13, domain: climate / glaciology / seismology).
